title: link/tasks read path folds references like the rollup (referenceKey), fold-table ICU digest pin, generator nits (#745 verdict should-fix 1 and 2)
description: From the Opus round-2 verdict on #745 (approved at feaad1c1, merged as a127c2d7). SHOULD-FIX 1 (in 0.15.1, leader ruling M2): src/commands/link.ts verifiedViewTask (:884-885) still compares detail.id and aliases with toLowerCase, while the rollup path (check, sync) now matches by referenceKey (NFC plus per-code-point fold, as quest's aliasKey). For a task whose id or alias is straße, a concept linking STRASSE resolves in check/sync but lore link / lore tasks / lore orphans throws not_found 'resolved to a different task'; the same for an NFD spelling of an NFC alias. Fix: compare with referenceKey (export it from the adapter or move it to a shared module). SHOULD-FIX 2 (M3, same PR if small): the 297-entry fold table is a delta against the generating node's toLowerCase, and referenceKey relies on the RUNNING bun's toLowerCase for everything else, which can differ by platform ICU; nothing checks it. Add a bun test pinning a digest of cp -> cp.toLowerCase() over U+0000..U+10FFFF, have the generator print that digest plus process.versions.icu and process.versions.unicode; it runs on all CI OSes. If the digest differs between OSes in CI, STOP and report per-OS values (a pair question), do not pick one. M4 nits: scripts/gen-case-fold-table.mjs:115 readCommitted should anchor the block end on the two-character sequence semicolon-newline rather than the first semicolon; reword the quest.ts rollupIndex docblock line that says the per-task path rejects a malformed-aliases record as drift (a real quest fails the whole load for a malformed aliases, so a per-task view fails for every reference). Handshake line to record on LBUMP/LCLI-469: lore's fold table is pinned to unicode-case-folding 1.1.1; a quest lockfile bump of that library must re-run gen-case-fold-table. FLOOR: scripts/ change gets a reviewer pass; no .github/, dependencies or lockfile.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore link, lore tasks and lore orphans resolve a task whose id or alias is straße when referenced as STRASSE, and an NFC alias referenced in NFD, via referenceKey; each test red without the fix.

A bun test pins the digest of toLowerCase over U+0000..U+10FFFF and the generator prints the digest plus ICU and Unicode versions; per-OS CI values compared, any difference reported rather than resolved.
Generator block-end anchor and the rollupIndex docblock wording fixed.
The pair-release handshake line about unicode-case-folding 1.1.1 is recorded on the release task.
